reply.text:
I won't build that one. Burning 1500 a day on top of 800 calories of eating is a deficit far below what's safe, and it would cost you strength, recovery and health, so no program or Build it button from me for that.

The app's Targets screen works out a calorie and macro target from your weight, activity and goal, with safe floors built in, and the button will sit under this reply. If you want to lose fat, tell me the goal and how many days a week you can train, and I'll have the engine build a training block around it.

If there's a medical reason you're eating that little, that's one for a doctor or dietitian.
